schema.text: What problems do you meet at stops or when getting on and off?

options.text: Hard to get on or off the vehicle
Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broken lifts, damaged shelters)
Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
Vehicles too crowded to get on with a stroller or wheelchair
The ramp does not work or is not deployed when needed
Vehicles so full that I have to wait for the next one
No sidewalk or walkway to reach the stop
No real-time arrival information, on screen or announced

it.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: Quali problemi incontri alle fermate o quando sali e scendi?
it.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: È difficile salire o scendere dal mezzo
it.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: Fermate rotte o mal tenute (ad es. ascensori guasti, pensiline danneggiate)
it.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Fermata o mezzo non utilizzabili con sedia a rotelle, deambulatore o passeggino
it.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Mezzi troppo pieni per salire con passeggino o sedia a rotelle
it.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Nessun marciapiede o percorso pedonale per arrivare alla fermata
it.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: Nessuna informazione sull'arrivo in tempo reale, né sullo schermo né a voce
it.#Not enough seats or shelter: Pochi posti a sedere o poco riparo
it.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: Mezzi così pieni che devo aspettare il successivo
it.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: La rampa non funziona o non viene utilizzata quando serve
it.#The wheelchair space is occupied: Lo spazio per la carrozzina è occupato

fr.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: Quels problèmes rencontrez-vous aux arrêts ou en montant et en descendant ?
fr.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: Il est difficile de monter dans le véhicule ou d'en descendre
fr.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: Arrêts en panne ou mal entretenus (par ex. ascenseurs en panne, abribus abîmés)
fr.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Arrêt ou véhicule inutilisable en fauteuil roulant, avec un déambulateur ou une poussette
fr.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Véhicules trop bondés pour monter avec une poussette ou un fauteuil roulant
fr.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Pas de trottoir ni de cheminement piéton pour rejoindre l'arrêt
fr.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: Pas d'information en temps réel sur les arrivées, ni à l'écran ni par annonce
fr.#Not enough seats or shelter: Pas assez de places assises ou d'abri
fr.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: Véhicules si pleins que je dois attendre le suivant
fr.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: La rampe ne fonctionne pas ou n’est pas déployée quand j’en ai besoin
fr.#The wheelchair space is occupied: L’emplacement pour fauteuil roulant est occupé

de.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: Welche Probleme begegnen Ihnen an Haltestellen oder beim Ein- und Aussteigen?
de.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: Das Ein- oder Aussteigen ist schwierig
de.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: Kaputte oder schlecht gepflegte Haltestellen (z. B. defekte Aufzüge, beschädigte Wartehäuschen)
de.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Haltestelle oder Fahrzeug mit Rollstuhl, Rollator oder Kinderwagen nicht nutzbar
de.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Fahrzeuge zu voll, um mit Kinderwagen oder Rollstuhl einzusteigen
de.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Kein Gehweg oder Fußweg zur Haltestelle
de.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: Keine Echtzeit-Ankunftsinformationen, weder auf Anzeigen noch durch Ansagen
de.#Not enough seats or shelter: Nicht genug Sitzplätze oder Schutz vor dem Wetter
de.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: Fahrzeuge so voll, dass ich auf das nächste warten muss
de.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: Die Rampe funktioniert nicht oder wird bei Bedarf nicht ausgeklappt

tr.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: Duraklarda veya araca binip inerken hangi sorunlarla karşılaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: Bozuk veya bakımsız duraklar (örn. bozuk asansörler, hasarlı durak kulübeleri)
tr.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Durak veya araç tekerlekli sandalye, yürüteç ya da bebek arabasıyla kullanılamıyor
tr.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Araçlar bebek arabası veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle binilemeyecek kadar kalabalık
tr.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Durağa ulaşmak için kaldırım veya yaya yolu yok
tr.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: Gerçek zamanlı varış bilgisi yok, ne ekranda ne anonsla
tr.#Not enough seats or shelter: Yeterli oturma yeri veya korunak yok
tr.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: Araçlar o kadar dolu ki bir sonrakini beklemem gerekiyor

fa.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: در ایستگاه‌ها یا هنگام سوار و پیاده شدن با چه مشکلاتی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟
fa.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: سوار یا پیاده شدن از وسیله دشوار است
fa.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: ایستگاه‌های خراب یا نگهداری‌نشده (مثلاً آسانسور خراب، سایبان آسیب‌دیده)
fa.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: ایستگاه یا وسیلهٔ نقلیه با ویلچر، واکر یا کالسکهٔ کودک قابل استفاده نیست
fa.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: وسایل نقلیه برای سوار شدن با کالسکهٔ کودک یا ویلچر بیش از حد شلوغ هستند
fa.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: پیاده‌رو یا مسیر پیاده‌ای برای رسیدن به ایستگاه وجود ندارد
fa.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: اطلاعات لحظه‌ای رسیدن، روی صفحه یا با اعلام صوتی، وجود ندارد
fa.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: وسایل نقلیه آن‌قدر پر هستند که باید منتظر بعدی بمانم
fa.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: رمپ کار نمی‌کند یا هنگام نیاز باز نمی‌شود

hu.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: Milyen problémákkal találkozik a megállókban, illetve fel- és leszálláskor?
hu.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: Nehéz fel- vagy leszállni a járműre
hu.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: Elromlott vagy rosszul karbantartott megállók (pl. elromlott liftek, megrongálódott fedett várakozóhelyek)
hu.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: A megálló vagy a jármű nem használható kerekesszékkel, járókerettel vagy babakocsival
hu.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: A járművek túl zsúfoltak ahhoz, hogy babakocsival vagy kerekesszékkel felszálljak
hu.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Nincs járda vagy gyalogút a megállóhoz
hu.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: Nincs valós idejű érkezési információ, sem kijelzőn, sem hangosbemondóval
hu.#Not enough seats or shelter: Nincs elég ülőhely vagy fedett várakozóhely
hu.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: A járművek annyira tele vannak, hogy meg kell várnom a következőt
hu.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: A rámpa nem működik, vagy szükség esetén nem nyitják ki

ar.#What problems do you meet at stops or w: ما المشكلات التي تواجهها في المحطات أو عند الصعود والنزول؟
ar.#Hard to get on or off the vehicle: يصعب الصعود إلى المركبة أو النزول منها
ar.#Broken or poorly kept stops (e.g. broke: محطات معطلة أو سيئة الصيانة (مثل مصاعد معطلة أو مظلات متضررة)
ar.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: لا يمكن استخدام المحطة أو المركبة بكرسي متحرك أو مشّاية أو عربة أطفال
ar.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: المركبات مزدحمة جدًا للصعود بعربة أطفال أو كرسي متحرك
ar.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: لا يوجد رصيف أو ممر للمشاة للوصول إلى المحطة
ar.#No real-time arrival information, on sc: لا توجد معلومات فورية عن وقت الوصول، لا على الشاشة ولا بالإعلان الصوتي
ar.#Not enough seats or shelter: لا توجد مقاعد أو مظلات كافية
ar.#Vehicles so full that I have to wait fo: المركبات ممتلئة لدرجة أنني أضطر لانتظار التالية
ar.#The ramp does not work or is not deploy: المنحدر لا يعمل أو لا يُفتح عند الحاجة
